_readme: Add the relevant block below to your MCP client config. The server runs against the live production API (https://agents.aiscale.pro) by default — no local setup needed. Override PLATFORM_URL to point elsewhere.
_cursor_note: For Cursor, add the same mcpServers block to ~/.cursor/mcp.json (or Settings → MCP).
_smithery_note: To list on Smithery (smithery.ai): connect your GitHub repo ry4ever/ai-agent. Smithery auto-detects the MCP server at src/mcp/server.ts via the bin entry in package.json.
_payment_note: Leave MCP_PAYMENT_HEADER empty to explore services for free (calls return payment instructions on the paywalled routes). To make paid calls, set it to a valid base64 x402 payment proof and set MCP_AGENT_ADDRESS to your wallet.
